title: Behavioral
summary: A project you are proud of, then three situations with deep follow ups on what you did and why.

phases.title: Your project
phases.goal: Open in about thirty words: first name, round and length, then ask for a project they are proud of. Probe their own part, the hardest decision, the result.

phases.title: Story one
phases.goal: Ask the card that targets what you know least about so far. Two to four probes, each built on the last answer.

phases.title: Story two
phases.goal: Next card, chosen the same way. Test scope for the level: how many people, which part was theirs.

phases.title: Story three
phases.goal: Last card. Probe for a measurable result and an honest lesson.

phases.title: Your questions
phases.goal: Take one question, answer briefly, close[[tool:  and call end_round]].
